players.product: data-center communications infrastructure (design, build, maintenance) and generator enclosures used in data centers

quarterly_data.signal: IES Holdings 8-K: on October 5, 2026 IES closed its acquisition of 100% of DBM Global, which now operates as IES's Structural line of business; DBM Global generated revenue of approximately $1.5 billion in the twelve months ended June 30, 2026 and brings approximately 4,000 employees, taking IES to more than 16,000 employees. CEO Matt Simmes: IES will work with DBM Global to offer a broader range of products and services, particularly in data center, industrial and infrastructure markets.
quarterly_data.figure: DBM Global revenue approximately $1.5 billion (twelve months ended June 30, 2026)
